title: Classification of invertible modules on the projective line over any field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $P=\mathbf P^1_k$ with twists $\mathcal O_P(d)$ for $d\in\mathbf Z$ as in [def-sc-p1-standard], and let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_P$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. There is a unique integer $d\in\mathbf Z$ such that $\mathcal L\cong\mathcal O_P(d)$ as $\mathcal O_P$-modules. Uniqueness concerns the integer, not the isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, divisors-lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, specialized to n=1 and R=k a field; the transition convention is that of def-sc-p1-standard.

proof.text: Choose free generators g_0,g_1 of L on the standard charts by [lem-sfb-projective-line-standard-chart-frames]. Their restrictions are free generators, so IsFreeGenerator.exists_unit_smul_eq expresses g_0|=v g_1| for an overlap unit v.

Apply [lem-sfb-projective-line-overlap-unit-normalization] to v. Its chart unit a gives a new free generator a g_0; after restriction its transition is q^d. Together with g_1 this is actual TwistData of degree d on L.
Choose TwistData on O d from hO. The already proved source theorem TwistData.existsUnique_iso (the generator-preserving gluing comparison in [lem-sc-p1-twist-exists]) gives an isomorphism L ≅ O d.

For an isomorphism between two twisted modules, pull the target generators back using its inverse. IsFreeGenerator.app_hom and exists_unit_smul_eq write these as a g_0 and b g_1 for chart units. Restrict and use linearity, naturality and both TwistData relations. Injectivity of multiplication by g_1 on the overlap gives a| q^d=q^e b|. Then [lem-sfb-projective-line-transition-degree-separation] implies d=e. Apply this to the composite of one chosen isomorphism inverse with any other isomorphism to a twist.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BXJ, specialized to n=1; A9 implements frames, normalization, naturality, coefficient cancellation, and degree comparison, reusing the proved source TwistData.existsUnique_iso for gluing. The concrete Laurent overlap identification is split off.
